seo.title: Privacy Policy for This Site
seo.description: What this site collects, what it does not, and how analytics and cookies are handled. Written to be readable rather than legally exhaustive.

blocks.text: This is a static website. Pages are generated at build time and served as plain HTML files. There is no application server processing your requests and no user accounts.
Standard web server logs are retained by the hosting provider. These include IP address, user agent, requested path, and timestamp. They are used for measuring traffic volume and diagnosing failures.

If analytics are enabled, they are privacy-respecting and aggregate: no cross-site tracking, no advertising identifiers, no individual profiles. Analytics can be disabled entirely at the site level, and when disabled the site makes no third-party requests at all.
This site sets no cookies for tracking. There is no consent banner because there is nothing to consent to.

Outbound links to external sites are ordinary links. Following one takes you to a site with its own privacy policy, which this document does not cover. No embedded third-party scripts load on page view.
